description: Fixed SURA latency/performance workload. Covers every mission category: simple supported, complex supported, follow-up (2-turn), ambiguous/out-of-scope, insufficient-evidence, unresolved identity (M2C-18, fail-closed), and document-length / retrieval-count variation (single-chunk vs multi-chunk pages). expected_status values are the public API statuses asserted on every measured response, so the benchmark doubles as a correctness smoke gate. Versioned: do not edit in place; create workload_v2.json for changes.
